validation_notes: The right side of the chart shows a sharp V-shaped reversal: price dropped to ~190 in late July, then rallied strongly and consecutively to ~220 over just a few sessions. This is a breakout/impulsive move, not a converging triangle. There's no clear flat support line with lower highs compressing - instead we see a clean reversal and uptrend with increasing range, the opposite of compression. No credible descending triangle structure (flat support + falling resistance) is visible; the algorithm likely misread the V-bottom as consolidation. Prior to that, price action from mid-June to late-July shows a broader range/channel rather than a tightening wedge. Overall this looks like a trend reversal, not a triangle pattern forming near the apex.
